_doc: Revert-verify mutants for the CLI decline-fallback (req c67e4c69, scenario D1 — 'the label is what a consumer prints'). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py packages/cli/tests/integration/resolve-display-name.decline-fallback.spec.json after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). One mutant per guard of the diff: M1 the printed-name tier, M2 the reported-source tier — split because two different expressions produce them and a spec could print the label while still announcing 'basename'. L2 is the CONTROL (no label ⇒ filename) and must stay GREEN under both: the bare-UID alarm of req f17f7c57 scenario 3 is not touched by this change.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/resolve-display-name.ts

M1_label_tier_removed_from_printed_name._note: The literal pre-fix expression. Reddens L1 only: `source` is computed from hasLabel independently, so L3 stays green — which is the point of splitting them.

M2_source_null_branch_hardwired_to_basen._note: The literal pre-fix shape. Reddens L3 only: the printed name still falls to the label, so L1 stays green and the two tiers are proven independent.

M3_label_not_trimmed._note: Added after review round 1 (LOW): .trim() is a guard of this diff and had no mutant, so the L1/L3 fixtures now carry a PADDED label to make it load-bearing. hasLabel already gates on .trim().length > 0, so dropping the strip is cosmetic — a stray-whitespace name, not an inversion — but a guard of the diff without a mutant is not locked (§A8).
